units.source_text: 葵姬怀孕，还没有到临盆时期，大家漫不介意。

en.t: Lady Aoi was pregnant, but her time to give birth had not yet come, so everyone took it lightly.

units.source_text: 岂知忽然阵痛频频，显见即将分娩了。

en.t: Unexpectedly, her labor pains suddenly came one after another, making it clear that she was about to deliver.
The rites being held in various places then intensified their prayers.

units.source_text: 然而最顽强的那个魂灵，一直附在她身上，片刻不离。

en.t: Yet that most stubborn spirit remained attached to her body and would not leave her for even a moment.

units.source_text: 道行高深的法师都认为此怪少有，难于制治。

en.t: Even monks of profound spiritual power considered this apparition rare and difficult to subdue.

units.source_text: 费了很大法力，好容易镇服了。

en.t: After expending great ritual power, they finally managed to bring it under control.

units.source_text: 此怪便借葵姬之口说道：“请法师稍稍宽缓些，我有话要对大将说！”

en.t: The apparition then spoke through Lady Aoi's mouth: "Please, monks, ease your restraint a little. I have something to say to the Captain!"

units.source_text: 众侍女相与言道：“对了，其中必有详情。”

en.t: The waiting women said to one another, "Yes, there must be some deeper reason behind this."

units.source_text: 便把源氏大将请进帷屏里来。

en.t: So they invited Captain Genji inside the curtains and screens.

units.source_text: 左大臣夫妇想道：“看来大限到了，想是有遗言要对公子说吧。”

en.t: The Minister of the Left and his wife thought, "It seems her final hour has come; perhaps she has last words to say to the young lord."

units.source_text: 正在祈祷的僧众都放低了声音，诵读《法华经》，气象十分庄严。

en.t: The monks who were praying all lowered their voices and recited the Lotus Sutra, creating an atmosphere of great solemnity.
